claims.text: A 24-year-old male professional soccer player received a direct blow to the chest from an opponent’s knee during a match and felt severe, throbbing and shooting lower rib cage pain, 8/10 on a visual analog scale and aggravated by dorsal and lateral decubitus. Two weeks of conservative treatment by the team physiotherapist gave no improvement. He visited a sports clinic after about three weeks of pain and reported he could not sleep well because of it.
